styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep teal-green stage #17453B for hero and closing shots, warm off-white #F7F5F0 for infographic and trust shots, real soil and plant scenes for pain and comparison shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key and soft grounded contact shadows for product shots; soft natural daylight around 5500K for soil and plant scenes; one gentle accent glow allowed behind the product
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte dark pedestals and kraft-paper #E9E0D2 tabletop for granule work; natural crumbly soil outdoors for scene shots
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines only, no serif or handwritten fonts
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line leaf and cycle motifs only, single accent color, inside rounded info labels
styleLock.presentationRules: the bag stays upright and stable in scale across the set; hero angle is a slight 3/4; product never covered by props
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent natural gardening ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep teal-green stage background #17453B, warm off-white #F7F5F0, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one vitality green accent #3E8E6B; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key and soft grounded contact shadows, plus soft natural daylight for soil and plant scenes; modern geometric sans-serif headlines only; consistent rounded info labels with thin-line leaf motifs; clean commercial product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright bag presentation and scale with natural even margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 从 7 张颗粒有机肥详情长图切片提炼。品类取舍：taxonomy 无农资/肥料类目，沿用库内先例取 家居日用/驱虫。已剥离：源包装上的品牌字样与 logo、执行标准与登记证号、净含量等具体数值、源站_numeric_成分指标（有机质/总养分/pH 数值一律省略，不生成）、防治对象列表及源营销词；原文案全部改写为 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 槽位。源详情中保质期与容量等自相矛盾的文案未采信。产品一律 {product} 占位。信任镜改为可见的松散腐熟颗粒质感特写。
